properties.title: Turkey bans social media for kids under 15
properties.summary: The government of Turkey on Saturday formally banned access to social media platform for children under the age of 15. The law was published today following the Turkish Parliament’s adoption of the bill last April. The ban will come into force on Nov. 1. Social media platforms will have to “take the necessary technical and administrative measures, including age verification,” to implement the new rules, the law states. properties.title: EU’s new list of critical mineral projects focuses on clean energy metals
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The European Commission announced a new list of 46 projects Friday in a bid to diversify away from China’s grip on raw materials and establish its own mineral sovereignty. The projects span extraction, processing, recycling, and substitution for raw materials to supply the EU’s defense, automotive, clean tech and technology industries.
